prompt: Our compliance team has flagged three Monero transactions for a forensic audit (Case CASE-2024-XMR-007). The transaction IDs are listed in `/workspace/investigations/case_2024_001/txids_for_analysis.json`. For each transaction, we need a complete privacy and structural analysis. Please run the full analysis pipeline on each transaction and compile all results into a single file called `forensic_report.json`. The report must include, per transaction: the transaction ID, input count, ring size, mixin count, privacy score, fee amount, and whether the transaction meets our privacy adequacy standard. We need this to determine which transactions are compliant and which need to be flagged for further investigation.
